metadata.title: AlbaDrive — Albanian carpooling across Europe
metadata.description: Trusted carpooling for the Albanian diaspora. Geneva → Pristina, Munich → Tirana and more.

hero.subtitle: Trusted carpooling for the Albanian diaspora. Geneva → Pristina, Munich → Tirana and more.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to travel with the community.

step1.title: Search for a trip
step1.description: Browse available trips on the Europe ↔ Balkans corridor. Filter by departure city, destination and date.

step2.title: Book a seat
step2.description: Send a booking request to the driver with an optional message. Zero online payment.

step3.title: Travel together
step3.description: Once accepted, contact the driver directly on WhatsApp to organise the meeting point.

driverCta.title: Heading back to Albania or Kosovo?
driverCta.subtitle: Offer your trip and share costs with fellow travellers. Simple, free, community-driven.
